data.title: Slovenia vs Scotland: Lineups, Prediction, Betting Tips & Odds
data.content:
Scotland exited the World Cup group stage under Steve Clarke after defeats to nil against Morocco and Brazil, ending that era. Now Sebastien Pocognoli takes the reins, and with the likes of Andy Robertson and John McGinn to call on, there is genuine optimism about the direction of travel for the visitors.

## Slovenia vs Scotland Lineups & Team News

### Injuries & Suspensions

Slovenia: Benjamin Sesko (Injured/out), Z. Zaletel (Injured/out), N. Prelec (Injured/out), M. Ratnik (Injured/out) [...] Scotland: Kieran Tierney (Injured/out), Kenny McLean (Injured/out), Scott McTominay (Injured/out), Che Adams (Injured/out)

### Slovenia

The big blow for Slovenia is the absence of talisman Benjamin Sesko, who is nursing a shin injury and misses out. Andraz Sporar is expected to lead the line in his place, with Zaletel, Prelec and Ratnik also sidelined through injury.

### Scotland [...] Scotland arrive with a new man in the dugout, as Sebastien Pocognoli takes charge for the first time. He is without midfield duo Kenny McLean and Scott McTominay, but Oli McBurnie should spearhead the attack.

This is Nations League B business, with the two nations drawn alongside Switzerland and North Macedonia, and both sides desperate to open with a result.
